description: Infraestrutura de combate a incêndios is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Câmara Municipal de Cascais. Geographical data of fire-fighting infrastructures of the Municipality of Cascais. Source: GeoCascais - Map projection: WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Coverage: Câmara Municipal de Cascais. The portal shows the English title as "Fire-fighting infrastructure" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Câmara Municipal de Cascais. Its keywords include protecao-civil, dadosabertos-cascais-pt, infraestruturas. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, CSV, GEOJSON, SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
